The best comfort food in the area
Jun 2026 • Family
One of the best meals we have had during our trip to Vietnam.

After several days enjoying Vietnamese cuisine, we missed a bit of more European food, and this place has undoubtedly been the best comfort food of the entire trip (despite also offering local food).

The restaurant is very clean, elegant, and has a very pleasant atmosphere. In addition, it has exceptional service, with special mention for Ha, who attended to us with a smile at all times, being very kind and attentive.

We ordered some breaded shrimp with green rice and two plates of pasta, and I can say that it was the best pasta we have eaten in Vietnam. Everything was delicious and perfectly prepared.

The only downside is not having discovered this restaurant earlier, because we would have come to dine here every day we were in Can Tho.

Highly recommended.

Great food overall
Jan 2026 • Couples
The restaurant is nice and cozy. We ate there 3 days for dinner and a couple of times for lunch. 

Remember to book a table if you want to be sure to sit outside. 

The food was overall delicious and we would especially recommend the fresh spring rolls for starters and the steak fillet which was cooked perfectly and had a great peber sauce on the side (you can ask for more sauce, as there is not so much per standard) 

The banan pancake was a great dessert as well if you have a sweet tooth. 

The service was also great and the staff were very friendly and helpful. 

On another note we also tried the grilled chicken and the “grilled” lamb chops which we didn’t like. The chicken was a bit dry and the lamb chops were coated in some carrot purée which seemed weird as you would expect it on the side, this meant that the meat didn’t have the hard grill taste which is what we normally love with a crispy chop, so recommend to stick to the steak at least for the “western food” 

Back to the positive the soups were also delicious and the pricing of the food was generally really fair. 

All the best, 
G&A
